runs.summary: Data through Oct 16 (Q4 12-day partial). Top 3: XLE +55.7%, SMH +49.9%, CIBR +38.7%. SPY P/E: 24.79x (P/E feed live again)
runs.content:
Top 5 YTD 2026: XLE +55.7% (P/E 19.44x, Fair), SMH +49.9% (30.57x, Elevated), CIBR +38.7% (34.43x, Elevated), XLK +27.9% (32.09x, Elevated), AMLP +18.6% (14.74x, Cheap).

Bottom 5 YTD 2026: JETS -7.9% (14.05x, Cheap), XLC -5.4% (16.18x, Fair), XLY -5.2% (26.54x, Elevated), GLD -3.6% (P/E N/A), XME -2.4% / ITA -2.4% (17.22x Fair / 32.52x Elevated).

Notable shifts: Tech sell-off week: SMH -10.5%, CIBR -10.2%, XLK -7.8%. XLE overtook SMH as the #1 sector YTD. The P/E feed un-froze after 4 weeks (same script), giving these band crossings: SMH and CIBR Expensive -> Elevated (the Expensive band is now empty), XLP Fair -> Elevated, GDX Fair -> Cheap, XRT Cheap -> Fair. XBI now reports 20.99x (profitable holdings only). XLV jumped from 25.0x to 32.8x; this needs a second print to confirm. Momentum changes: XLE -> Accelerating; SMH and XBI -> Fading; CIBR and XLK -> Consolidating; XLU and XRT Reversing -> Fading (back to positive YTD); ICLN and XME Fading -> Reversing (now negative YTD). Defensives are rotating up in Q4 (XLP +8.7%, XLU +7.0%, KIE +7.0%). SPY is +12.8% YTD (Q4 +0.1%), and 9 of 25 sectors beat it.

runs.content:

Notable shifts: Rotation within tech. SMH fell ~4.4% on the week (Q4 partial +3.6% -> -0.9%), while CIBR gained ~5% (Q4 +6.7%), cutting the gap between them from 28 to 13pp. One momentum change: JETS Fading -> Reversing (YTD now negative). XLF and KIE are back to positive YTD, so 7 sectors are negative YTD (down from 8). Defensives bounced (XLU +5.0%, XLP +3.5% in Q4); XLU and XLY stay Reversing until a full quarter confirms. SPY is +15.1% YTD, and 6 of 25 sectors beat it. No P/E band crossings: all P/Es identical for a 4th straight week, so replacing the P/E source is overdue.
